$comment: Product safety warnings for the product-page safety block (GPSR (EU) 2023/988 Art. 19). Only approved statements from the Incutec safety leaflet (document DOC-SAFETY-OPENDRONE) are copied in here, unchanged, per product family and language. Warnings render only while approved is true and documentVersion names the approved leaflet version; with approved false the block shows manufacturer, address, email and product identifier only.
